note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, only the soldier and worker being described; the worker antennae are recorded as 'more than 10 segments', their exact number not being supplied; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, antennae, labrum and legs straw yellow, thorax and abdomen nearly white. Head rather densely pilose, body moderately pilose. Body length 3.5–3.75 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, lateral margins slightly convex; frontal projection long and pointed, extending far beyond the mandible base (head length to mandible base 1.00–1.08 mm, to apex of frontal projection 1.22–1.25 mm, frontal projection length 0.22 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.88 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of labrum deeply incurved (median length 0.22 mm, maximum width 0.28 mm). Mandibles longer than head (length 1.11 mm, mandible length/head length 1.08). Postmentum rod-like (length 0.42 mm, maximum width 0.28 mm, waist width 0.22 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, neither anterior nor posterior margin notched (length 0.14 mm, width 0.42 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, antennae, thorax, legs and abdomen nearly white; head capsule and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.30 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to apex of labrum 0.94 mm, length to mandible base 0.61 mm, maximum width 0.80 mm). Antennae with more than 10 segments, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus half as long as wide, inflated and pilose (length 0.19 mm, width 0.36 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.28 mm, width 0.53 mm), neither anterior nor posterior margin notched.
